currency_conversion_institution_name_val.name: currency_conversion_institution_name_valid
currency_conversion_institution_name_val.value: ("currency_conversion"."institution_kind" is null and "currency_conversion"."institution_name" is null) or ("currency_conversion"."institution_kind" in ('itau', 'prex') and "currency_conversion"."institution_name" is not null) or ("currency_conversion"."institution_kind" = 'other' and "currency_conversion"."institution_name" is not null and btrim("currency_conversion"."institution_name") <> '')

financial_account_opening_valid.name: financial_account_opening_valid
financial_account_opening_valid.value: ("financial_account"."opening_balance" is null and "financial_account"."opening_date" is null) or ("financial_account"."opening_balance" is not null and "financial_account"."opening_date" is not null and "financial_account"."opening_balance" >= 0)

pending_entry_discard_state_valid.name: pending_entry_discard_state_valid
pending_entry_discard_state_valid.value: ("pending_entry"."status" = 'discarded' and "pending_entry"."discarded_at" is not null) or ("pending_entry"."status" = 'pending' and "pending_entry"."discarded_at" is null)
